groups.label: Basics
groups.description: The fields every target has, shown first in the Details tab.

groups.label: Notes
groups.description: Free-form notes in Markdown, written in the Edit tab and shown in Overview.

fields.label: ID
fields.description: The target's permanent id. It never changes, so you can copy it to point to this target from notes, prompts or other tools.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: A short name you will recognize in lists and on the calendar. Add the year or the round when the same program or channel comes back.

fields.label: Categories, subcategories and types
fields.description: Where this target sits in your category library. Pick one or more; the first is the primary, and a target with none shows as Uncategorized.

fields.label: Kind
fields.description: Whether you can act on this now, or are watching it for a later round or a better fit.

options.label: Opportunity
options.description: Open now or soon, and worth applying to or taking part in.

options.label: Watchlist
options.description: Closed, not open yet or not a fit yet, but worth checking again, for example at the next intake.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Where this target stands. Statuses are the same in every section, grouped as Planned, In progress, Done and Closed, and new targets start as New.

fields.label: Next action date
fields.description: The day you plan to take the next action. The focus queue and the calendar use this date.

fields.label: Next action time
fields.description: An optional time for the next action, such as a call or a post that has to go out at a set hour. Leave it empty when any time that day will do.

fields.label: Organization
fields.description: The company, fund, community, publication or public body behind this target. Leave it empty when the name already says it.

fields.label: Link
fields.description: The main web page for this target. It shows as the link banner in Overview.

fields.label: Priority
fields.description: How much this target matters next to your other targets, from Very high to Very low. New targets start at Medium.

fields.label: Next action
fields.description: The one concrete step that moves this target forward, written so you can start on it without rereading the notes.

fields.label: Deadline
fields.description: A cut-off set by someone else, such as the moment applications close, entered in your own time zone. Your own plan goes in the next action date.

fields.label: Owner
fields.description: The person on your team who is responsible for this target and its next action.

fields.label: Campaign
fields.description: The campaign this target is part of, such as a launch or a fundraising push. Campaigns are shared by all your startups and managed in Extra > Campaigns.

fields.label: Funding round
fields.description: The funding round this target belongs to, such as your pre-seed or seed raise. Rounds are listed in the Funding rounds panel of the Funding page.

fields.label: Tags
fields.description: Short labels for grouping and filtering targets across sections. Tags are shared by all your startups and managed in Extra > Tags.

fields.label: Repeat
fields.description: How often this target comes back, as every so many days, weeks or months, for example a monthly community thread or a yearly program. Leave it empty for a one-off.

fields.label: Notes
fields.description: Free-form Markdown for anything that does not fit a field, such as drafts or call notes. You write it in the Edit tab and read it in Overview.

activities.label: Key dates and milestones
activities.description: Other dates that matter for this target besides the next action and the deadline, such as an info session or a demo day. They show on the calendar.

fields.label: Milestone
fields.description: What happens on that date, in a few words.

fields.label: Date
fields.description: The day it happens.

fields.label: Time
fields.description: The time it starts, if that matters. Leave it empty for an all-day date.

activities.label: Update log
activities.description: A dated record of what happened with this target and what comes next. Add an entry after each reply, call, submission or decision.

fields.label: Date
fields.description: The day it happened.

fields.label: Time
fields.description: The time it happened, if that matters, for example for a call.

fields.label: What happened
fields.description: The kind of event, so you can scan the log quickly.

options.label: Research or check
options.description: You looked into it, or checked facts and fit.

options.label: Sent or submitted
options.description: You sent a message, pitch, post or application.

options.label: Follow-up
options.description: You followed up on something you had already sent.

options.label: Call or meeting
options.description: You talked live, for example in a call, meeting, interview or pitch.

options.label: Published or live
options.description: Something went live, such as a post or a listing.

options.label: Decision
options.description: Either side said yes or no.

options.label: Other
options.description: Anything else worth keeping in the log.

fields.label: Outcome
fields.description: What came of it, in a sentence or two.
fields.example: e.g. They want a demo before the jury meets

fields.label: Next action
fields.description: The next step this leads to.

fields.label: Next action date
fields.description: When you plan to take that next step.

fields.label: Status after
fields.description: The target's status once this update is in.

fields.label: Source URL
fields.description: A link to the email, message, post or page this update is about.

fields.label: Notes
fields.description: Anything else worth keeping about this update.
